gates: https://www.superstreetonline.com/ redirects to https://www.motortrend.com/super-street-online (known MotorTrend bot-wall gate): stopped, content not used.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=... pages redirect to https://www.google.com/sorry/ ('unusual traffic' CAPTCHA, HTTP 429): not bypassed; only search-result snippets were read. WebFetch returned only the page footer.
https://www.pettitracing.com/ : Cloudflare managed challenge 'Verifying your connection... Enable JavaScript and cookies to continue' (HTTP 429): not bypassed.
https://www.realstreetperformance.com/ : Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' (HTTP 403): not bypassed.

https://mkiv.com/techarticles/how_to_dyno/index.html and https://www.mazdatrix.com/sitemap_index.xml : SiteGround 'One moment, please...' page: not bypassed. (dsportmag.com shows the same page intermittently; plain retries after a pause returned the articles - no challenge solved.)

https://www.garrettmotion.com/news/newsroom/article/this-garrett-turbocharged-toyota-supra-giveaway-car-from-motion-auto-made-400-horsepower/ : embedded video says 'Please accept marketing cookies to view this content' - not accepted.

Not rule-13 gates but unreachable: evanstuning.com and speedhunters.com (proxy CONNECT 502), boostlogic.net and 2jzpower.com (connection reset), www2u.biglobe.ne.jp/~fam (Japanese Dynapack list cited on AusRotary; 404, site gone; web.archive.org unreachable).
robots.txt respected: bringatrailer.com disallows /search/ and /?q= (not used); only listing pages were sampled (44 pages, 1.5 s apart).
notFound: Session WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200) when this pass started: no web searches were possible; leads came from site sitemaps, site-internal search pages (DSPORT sitemap, mkivsupra.net search, AusRotary search, YouTube results page) and direct URLs.

A stock US Supra Turbo (6MT or auto) on a Dynojet/Dynapack with a readable sheet: not found. Bring a Trailer sample (44 Supra listings) found 2 listings with dyno results, both modified (1994-toyota-supra-196: 'dynomometer test results'; 1994-toyota-supra-201: '674 horsepower'); the full BaT scan was not completed for lack of time.
A US stock-twins + boost-controller build at 15-19 psi on a Dynojet: not found (the Trinidad car is at 15 psi on stock ECU + FCD but outside the US).
Garrett-turbo (GTX/GT35) Supra on stock cams with a Dynojet/Dynapack sheet and printed correction: not found (the DSPORT GT3582R car has no correction and runs 110-octane).

RX-7 FD3S: no new stock-port Dynojet/Dynapack build with printed correction was found this pass. Stock FD Dynojet sheets exist on rx7club/rx8club/nopistons (blocked) and Pettit (Cloudflare). DSPORT's online archive has no Supra or RX-7 Test & Tune pages (only features).

Compressor-map figures for Precision T6266SP / 6765 (precisionturbo.com gated) and for the factory CT12B twins (no maker map published): not found. Garrett GT3582R/GT35R figures are copied from the earlier Supra file; their map reference temperature/pressure were not verified.
Titan Motorsports blog/customer pages: no MKIV dyno sheets (checked Atom feeds). Garrett 'On vehicle performance for 1JZ/2JZ' page: all examples are engine swaps into other chassis.
